exposure.note: Display thresholds for the demo, not validated rules. near_m: a flooded road this close makes a facility potentially exposed. frontage_m: a closed or truck-risky road this close puts access under review.

sources.purpose: Road flood state and Floodboard's per-vehicle verdict
sources.quality_notes: A fusion of Traffy, crowd reports and BMA sensors. No feature IDs; GRP identifies a segment by a hash of its geometry. Features marked zone, estimated, inferred or cluster are Floodboard's own derivations. The verdict is Floodboard's estimate, not a BMA rule.

sources.purpose: Point reports behind the road states, about the last 24 hours
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 for the export; quoted text may carry other terms
sources.pii: Report text and links can identify people. GRP keeps only a hash of the text and never displays it.
sources.redistribution: Export allowed with attribution; quoted text not cleared
sources.quality_notes: Each row names its underlying source (traffy, crowd, bma_sensor, bma_dds, news). A sensor keeps one ID across readings.
